findings.location: Paragraph beginning “Parece-me que Deus…”; quotation of Revelation 4:11
findings.source_quote: “for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “por tua vontade elas existem e foram criadas” with “para teu prazer elas existem e foram criadas” (or an equivalent rendering that preserves “for thy pleasure”).
findings.translation_quote: “porque criaste todas as coisas, e por tua vontade elas existem e foram criadas.”
